cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.
Vitest with jsdom and Testing Library.
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID
HMS-4 REQ-3 (S-1 AC4): shows the hospital-local day as returned
Without either, database tests are skipped.
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script)
In the MVP every request is the actor `staff` and every permission is granted.
REQ-1, REQ-8, REQ-12: the web column, its "-" placeholder and the column order are tested.
AC4: The Next appointment column shows the same values as before the change.

findings.suggested_fix: Under Known, say that REQ-12 values are guarded by the passing patients-next-appointment.test.ts (HMS-1) suite.
findings.text: REQ-12 is traced only to a column-order test. S-3 AC4 needs the Next appointment values to stay the same, and the artifact does not name the existing HMS-1 next-appointment tests that guard those values.

rubric_items.reason: The repo subquery, the service day mapping and the web column are all tested. REQ-10 and REQ-11 now have HMS-4 tests on data that has a last visit. The trace covers REQ-1 to REQ-13, the same as impl.

Assertions check results you can observe: the day in each zone, null, '-', column order, 400 status with field keys equal to ['status'], an empty page past the end that keeps the total, and no raw instant or medical history.

Edge cases: no appointments, only Scheduled, a later Cancelled, No-show or Scheduled appointment, closing order versus start order, two zones. Error paths: invalid page (400) and invalid status filter (400). The F-1 gap is closed.
API tests use Vitest and Supertest on a throwaway PostgreSQL, in api/test. Web tests use Vitest, jsdom and Testing Library, in web/src/__tests__. Every test name now leads with HMS-4 and a REQ id.
The artifact invents no numbers. It points to the verifier test.log for counts and says coverage is not available. The log shows 13 tests in patients-last-visit.test.ts, and all suites pass.
